Note: #1531 includes tests that should be ported into #1511.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1511 is the more robust fix: it adds content-type detection in `_handle_token_response` and parses URL-encoded responses, handling servers that return non-JSON regardless of request headers. PR #1531 only adds `Accept: application/json` to outgoing requests, which relies on servers honoring the header — servers that always return URL-encoded format will still break. The ideal solution combines both (request JSON via Accept, but also handle URL-encoded responses defensively); #1511 is the better base since #1531's two-line header additions can be folded in trivially. Note: #1531 includes tests that should be ported into #1511.

members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs fix this by iterating `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and calling `writer.close()`, and both add graceful session termination to the `lifespan` shutdown path in `streamable_http_manager.py`. (2 PRs)

members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2259 is a strict superset of #2253: it includes the same SSE writer cleanup and lifespan shutdown logic, and additionally adds an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) to prevent double-termination. It also omits the `# pragma: no cover` annotation on the writer-close loop that #2253 adds, keeping that branch visible to the test suite.
